senses.gloss: और्ध्वदेह और्ध्वदेह, i. e. ऊर्ध्व-देह + अ, n. Obsequies of a deceased person, Rām. 2, 83, 24.

और्ध्वदेहिक और्ध्वदेहिक, i. e. ऊर्ध्व-देह + इक,
 I. adj.
 1. Serving for the acquisition of merit, Man. 11, 10.
 2. Belonging to the obsequies of a deceased person, Pañc. 9, 3.
 II. n. Obsequies, Rām. 4, 24, 24.
